Recall the following special limit: 

$$
e={lim}_{n\to \infty }{(1+\frac{1}{n})}^{n}
$$

Now, we rewrite the given limit using the algebra of limits, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{n\to \infty }{(1+\frac{1}{n})}^{2n(x+y)} & ={lim}_{n\to \infty }{[{(1+\frac{1}{n})}^{n}]}^{2(x+y)} \\  & ={[{lim}_{n\to \infty }{(1+\frac{1}{n})}^{n}]}^{2(x+y)} \\  & ={e}^{2(x+y)}\end{aligned}
$$
